title: Tiny, cute pear
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='pearBody' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#d9f25b'/>
      <stop offset='60%' stop-color='#a8d92e'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#7ab81f'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- main pear body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='62' rx='27' ry='28' fill='url(#pearBody)'/>
  <!-- neck / top narrow part -->
  <path d='M50 36 C40 36 34 46 38 56 C41 62 44 64 50 64 C56 64 59 62 62 56 C66 46 60 36 50 36 Z' fill='#b8e63a'/>
  <!-- belly highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='66' rx='10' ry='12' fill='#e8f98a' opacity='0.75'/>
  <!-- blush cheeks -->
  <ellipse cx='35' cy='66' rx='5' ry='3.5' fill='#ff9a76' opacity='0.85'/>
  <ellipse cx='65' cy='66' rx='5' ry='3.5' fill='#ff9a76' opacity='0.85'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='58' rx='3.2' ry='4' fill='#2b4a1c'/>
  <ellipse cx='58' cy='58' rx='3.2' ry='4' fill='#2b4a1c'/>
  <circle cx='43' cy='56.5' r='1.1' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='59' cy='56.5' r='1.1' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M45 68 Q50 73 55 68' stroke='#2b4a1c' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- stem -->
  <path d='M50 34 Q49 26 53 21' stroke='#6b4a1f' stroke-width='4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- tiny leaf -->
  <path d='M52 27 C60 22 66 24 67 29 C62 32 55 31 52 27 Z' fill='#4faf3a'/>
  <path d='M53 28 Q60 27 65 28' stroke='#3b8a2a' stroke-width='1.3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
